scope: Simplification of the light Mixer marketing website after user feedback that it felt text-dense. No engine, release, legal, physical-device or GA qualification.

tools.browser: Google Chrome 155.0.8059.82 headless via DevTools protocol; Claude desktop in-app browser, version not exposed

changes: Cut eyebrows, two-line headings, card paragraphs, captions and the tools strip; each section is one headline and one line.
Hero is a centered headline over an editor showing a MixerUI file that matches the screen drawn on the iPhone and Android phone beside it.
Workflow example previews both phones and applies the simulated update to both.
Delivery section is a three-card bento with rollout, signed-build pipeline and project-tree graphics; project folders follow the docs.
Pricing, FAQ and closing call to action trimmed; buttons use a pill shape across the site.
limitations: No public domain or production deployment; preview remains noindex.
Device, editor and control renderings are illustrations, not screenshots of Mixer-built apps.
Browser checks are desktop responsive emulation; physical phones remain disconnected.
No GA gate or accountable reviewer acceptance changed.
